description: Default permissions for the main ontology workbench window, narrowed to what the webview is measured to call. `core:default` expands to nine sets; this window needs two of them. Everything else the frontend does goes through app-defined commands, which capabilities do not gate, so granting core sets for them protects nothing. Capabilities gate JS-to-Rust IPC only: the window sizing this app does from Rust needs no `core:window` grant, which is why removing it changes nothing.
